scope: Prospectively specified test of the discrete whole-transition first response in one conditional host; continuum and physical-cluster conclusions require additional convergence and calibration
physical_inputs: Exactly the host, 60 Msun remnant, BH-only collisions, all-species smooth gravity, allowed/excluded encounter domain, region, horizon and table stopping rules of matched-residence-pilot-1

launches.name: radial_outward
launches.role: previously seen endpoint setting; independent replication

launches.name: tangential
launches.role: previously seen endpoint setting; independent replication

launches.name: oblique
launches.role: launch direction not used in the earlier endpoint pilot; prediction before independent endpoint validation

cache.scope: Lossless numerical storage only; bitwise sampler/RNG equivalence checked against original kernel; working arrays outside this budget

seed_scheme: SeedSequence([seed, stage_code, setting_index, launch_index, method_or_a_index]); codes 10 pilot, 20 prediction, 30 validation; no seed shared across stages

pilot.purpose: Compare estimator variance and computational cost; only weighted sample variance selects primary prediction sample count, never its mean/sign or validation outcomes

prediction.estimator: Uniform complete-transition replacement with zero/positive Poisson conditioning and antithetic Gaussian increments at K; four diffusion continuations with shared fixed-row noise
prediction.positive_branch: Poisson(Gamma*delta) conditioned N_events>0, including multiple encounters; at zero rate its weight is zero
prediction.gaussian_branches: A*delta plus or minus sqrt(D*delta)*Z; drift sign unchanged
prediction.selection: K uniform over all N scheduled steps, independent per quartet; dead-before-K rows retained with zero response
prediction.primary_count_rule: Smallest power of two >= max(minimum, z_Bonferroni^2 * pilot_weighted_variance / target_halfwidth^2), capped at maximum. Lock all selected counts before production. A cap hit is retained, not a precision claim.
prediction.state_diagnostics: Retain insertion step, active flag and pre-transition state; report signed contributions by predeclared time and radius bins with all rows in denominator

validation.transition_family: P_a=(1-a)P_D+a*P_J including full transition reward and stopping outcomes; independent Bernoulli choice each scheduled step
validation.coupling: Each mixture path paired with its own diffusion control through fixed-shape Gaussian and exponential variates; each branch uses its own state-dependent hazard. Different validation settings and all prediction batches independent.
validation.execution_gate: All prediction arrays and a digest-locked prediction register must exist before any validation trajectories are generated
validation.known_endpoints: Prior endpoint results are development evidence, not blind validation. Fresh seeds at original launches test replication; the oblique launch tests an unused direction with the estimator fixed beforehand.

reporting.family_scope: Conservative allowance covering 9 response means, 21 validation shifts, 21 prediction residuals, 6 response-refinement contrasts, and 6 endpoint-refinement contrasts (63 statements); duplicated scaled-response intervals inherit their original response event. Normal approximations, not exact finite-sample guarantees.
reporting.small_a_test: Compare [mu(a)-mu(0)]/a with S at both 0.05 and 0.1; report the remainder/a with its interval. A finite a is not an exact derivative test and an interval containing zero is not equivalence.
reporting.endpoint_test: For a=1 compare [mu(1)-mu(0)]-S with the predeclared absolute error tolerance; intervals wholly within support finite-resolution agreement, wholly outside establish disagreement, overlap is inconclusive.
reporting.continuum_gate: No continuum claim unless sampling, response and endpoint grid/time sensitivity, numerical-domain continuation uncertainty, and local-kernel resolution are adequately controlled. Finite refinement shifts are not rigorous truncation bounds.
reporting.weighted_censoring: Bound possible response continuation pathwise by N * [p0*B_zero+pplus*B_positive+(B_Dplus+B_Dminus)/2], B=(T-stop_time)/T for numerical-domain stops only. Preserve all weighted branches and do not renormalize survivors.
reporting.precision: Normal intervals can be unreliable for rare influential contributions; retain extrema, standard errors, and contribution diagnostics. Resource-limited inconclusive results are reported without widening acceptance thresholds.
reporting.claims: No capture, merger-rate, distributional-response, host-feedback or calibrated real-cluster claim; this tests a mean-residence predictor.
